query:
SELECT id, cardId, grade, price, currency, jpyPrice, soldAt, source, listingUrl
FROM priceHistory
WHERE grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
  AND jpyPrice IS NULL
ORDER BY soldAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
